pages.text: The pyre inspires loyal $(l:goety:mutations/illager_servants)Neollagers$() to train themselves. To have the Neollager train at a pyre, simply $(l:goety:focuses/command_focus)Command$() / $(l:goety:focuses/order_focus)Order$() them to it. If 'illagerServantAutoTrain' is enabled, simply have them near one. Depending on its surroundings, much like $(l:rituals/dark_altar)Altars$(), will allow the Neollager to train into a specific Illager subtype. Each pyre can only train up to 8 Trainable Illagers.

pages.title: Pillager Servants
pages.text: $(o)Note: Neollagers are quicker to train into Pillager Servants$()$(br)Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)2 Hay/Target Blocks $(li)2 Carved Pumpkins $(li)16 Wooden Fences $(li)20 Wools

pages.title: Piker Servants
pages.text: $(o)Note: Owner must have read $(l:goety:rumors/desert)Front Scroll$()$()$(br)Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)2 Grindstone $(li)2 Smithing Tables $(li)16 Wooden Fences $(li)32 Logs $(li)4 Barrels $(li)4 Beds $(li)2 Anvils

pages.title: Vindicator Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)1 Banner $(li)64 Wooden Planks $(li)60 Bricks Blocks Any $(li)10 Walls $(li)10 Fences $(li)2 Furnaces $(li)1 Crafting Table

pages.title: Mountaineer Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Vindicator Servant $(li)Pyre must be in snowing biomes $(li)16 Wooden Fences $(li)20 Wools $(li)8 Barrels $(li)4 Powered Wind Blowers

pages.title: Crusher Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Neollager $(li)64 Wooden Planks $(li)64 Bricks Blocks Any $(li)8 Fences $(li)8 Blast Furnaces $(li)2 Lava Cauldrons $(li)2 Water Cauldrons $(li)4 Anvils

pages.title: Evoker Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Magic Neollager $(li)32 Bookshelves/Enchant Power $(li)16 Lit Candles $(li)4 Heads $(li)4 Filled Flower Pots $(li)2 Banners $(li)4 $(l:goety:crafts/stash_urn)Stash Urns$() $(li)1 Lectern

pages.title: Geomancer Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Magic Neollager $(li)16 Blocks of Amethysts $(li)64 Deepslate Blocks $(li)16 $(l:goety:crafts/creeper_totem)Creeper Totems$()

pages.title: Iceologer Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Magic Neollager $(li)16 Blue Ice $(li)64 Snow Blocks $(li)4 $(l:goety:crafts/artifice/freezing_lamp)Freezing Lamps$()

pages.title: Cryologer Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Iceologer Servant $(li)Pyre must be in snowing biomes $(li)16 Bookshelves/Enchant Power $(li)32 Powdered Snow $(li)16 $(l:goety:crafts/creeper_totem)Creeper Totems$()

pages.title: Wind Caller Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Magic Neollager $(li)64 Marble Blocks $(li)32 Jade Blocks $(li)4 Indented Gold Blocks

pages.title: Storm Caster Servants
pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Geomancer or Wind Caller $(li)Pyre must be exposed to Thunderstorm $(li)32 Copper Blocks Any $(li)64 Bricks Blocks Any $(li)4 Lightning Rods
To stop them from training, either remove the Pyre or move them more than 10 blocks away from it. If a training Illager is near Illagers they're training to become, they will train faster.
